article_title: Veterans shouldn't sleep rough this Christmas, Burnham says

tasks.prompt: What is the article mainly about?
options: Plans to ensure veterans sleeping rough are offered accommodation, plus debate about whether short-term funding is enough
A new programme that recruits homeless people into the armed forces
A proposal to close veterans' charities before Christmas
A survey about where tourists should stay in Manchester
tasks.correct_answer: Plans to ensure veterans sleeping rough are offered accommodation, plus debate about whether short-term funding is enough
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה עוסקת בתכנית להציע קורת גג ליוצאי צבא הישנים ברחוב ובדיון על הצורך בתמיכה ארוכת טווח.

tasks.prompt: What will the prime minister ask councils to do in his Armistice Day letter?
options: Build military bases in every city
Draw up plans to offer accommodation to veterans sleeping rough before Christmas
Send veterans to study in the EU
Replace local homelessness charities
tasks.correct_answer: Draw up plans to offer accommodation to veterans sleeping rough before Christmas
tasks.explanation_hebrew: ראש הממשלה אמור לבקש מהרשויות המקומיות להכין תכניות דיור ליוצאי צבא הישנים ברחוב לקראת חג המולד.

tasks.prompt: What is the additional £8.7m intended to support?
options: A new election campaign
International student exchanges
Eight organisations helping housing providers support veterans with complex needs
One temporary shelter in Greater Manchester
tasks.correct_answer: Eight organisations helping housing providers support veterans with complex needs
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הסכום הנוסף מיועד לשמונה ארגונים המסייעים לספקי דיור לתמוך ביוצאי צבא עם צרכים מורכבים, כולל בעיות בריאות או התמכרות.

tasks.prompt: What does “falling through the cracks” mean in James MacCleary's warning?
options: Damaging a building while looking for housing
Moving from one council area to another
Refusing every offer of support
Being missed by support systems and not receiving the help needed
tasks.correct_answer: Being missed by support systems and not receiving the help needed
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הביטוי מתאר אנשים שאינם מקבלים את העזרה הדרושה מפני שהם מתפספסים בין שירותים או מערכות שונות.

tasks.prompt: What did the latest official figures say about rough sleeping in England?
options: 4,793 people were estimated to be sleeping rough on one night in autumn 2025, a record high
Rough sleeping had ended completely by 2025
Only veterans were included in the figures
The number had fallen every year since 2021
tasks.correct_answer: 4,793 people were estimated to be sleeping rough on one night in autumn 2025, a record high
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הנתון הרשמי היה 4,793 אנשים בלילה אחד בסתיו 2025 — שיא, לאחר עלייה מאז 2021.

tasks.prompt: Why did Burnham say similar action was needed everywhere?
options: Local charities are not allowed to work together
Veterans can receive help only in their birthplace
A strong scheme in one area may attract people from nearby regions, so uneven action cannot end the wider problem
National funding can be used only by Manchester
tasks.correct_answer: A strong scheme in one area may attract people from nearby regions, so uneven action cannot end the wider problem
tasks.explanation_hebrew: ברנהם טען שתכנית חזקה באזור אחד מושכת אנשים מאזורים שכנים, ולכן רק פעולה דומה בכל מקום יכולה להתמודד עם הבעיה הרחבה.

tasks.prompt: List four parts of the proposed support for veterans sleeping rough.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין ארבעה מרכיבים קונקרטיים מתוך הכתבה.
expected_points: Councils should prepare accommodation plans before the festive period.
Part of the previously announced £874m should be used specifically to house veterans.
Councils should work with local organisations and charities.
An additional £8.7m will support eight specialist organisations.
Support should address complex needs such as health or addiction problems.
Veterans should be connected with housing and other specialist support.

tasks.prompt: Explain why MacCleary called the new funding an important first step but not a complete solution.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר את ההבדל בין עזרה מיידית לבין פתרון ארוך טווח ולכלול מניעה.
expected_points: The funding can provide immediate beds and specialist help.
Homelessness is described as a crisis built over many years.
A one-off payment may not let councils maintain services over time.
Long-term funding would support lasting local action.
Prevention is needed so veterans do not become homeless in the first place.

tasks.prompt: Summarise the veteran-housing pledge, funding, scale of rough sleeping and criticism in 4–5 sentences.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכלול את מטרת התכנית, מקורות המימון, הנתון הארצי והביקורת על מימון חד־פעמי.
expected_points: The prime minister plans to ask English councils to offer accommodation to veterans sleeping rough before Christmas.
Councils would use part of £874m already announced for homelessness.
Another £8.7m would help eight organisations support veterans with complex needs.
Official figures estimated 4,793 people slept rough on one night in autumn 2025, a record high.
Critics welcomed the step but called for long-term funding and prevention.

tasks.prompt: Write a short council action plan for helping veterans who are sleeping rough this winter.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציע תכנית מציאותית המבוססת על הכתבה וכוללת דיור, שותפים, צרכים מורכבים והמשכיות.
expected_points: Identify veterans sleeping rough and offer a bed quickly.
Work with local charities and specialist veterans' organisations.
Assess health, addiction and other complex needs.
Create an individual plan and a named source of continuing support.
Use funding for both immediate accommodation and prevention of future homelessness.
